financial_package.note: Pay Scale J-1 under Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) implemented by Government of Maharashtra Law & Judiciary Department per Supreme Court judgment in All India Judges Association v. Union of India.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) Pay Matrix J-1 (₹77,840 - ₹1,36,520), Supreme Court WP(C) No. 643/2015
financial_package.estimate_note: Basic pay ₹77,840 in Scale J-1. Gross calculated with 58% DA (₹45,147) plus judicial HRA (up to 27% in municipal corporation areas or earmarked judicial quarters), Sumptuary allowance, Robe allowance, Electricity & Water allowance, minus judicial pension contributions and professional tax.
official_perks: Official earmarked judicial residential bungalow / quarters or full judicial HRA
Official judicial staff support (Orderly/Peon, Judicial Stenographer, Bench Clerk)
Conveyance allowance / staff car facility or fuel reimbursement for official duty
Sumptuary allowance and robe allowance per SNJPC recommendations
Law library book allowance, legal database subscription, and official laptop provision
Comprehensive medical facilities for judge, spouse, and dependent family members
Subsidized telephone, broadband internet, electricity, and water allowances
